title: coryphantha pallida subsp. pseudoradians
intro: Coryphantha pallida subsp. pseudoradians, commonly known as the "false rainbow cactus," is a type of cactus that belongs to the Echinocereus genus. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coryphantha pallida subsp. pseudoradians include its ability to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and alkaloids, contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
